note: Campground on the northeast edge of Titonka beside the city pool, with the grocery store in walking distance. Buffalo Creek, here a straightened drainage channel, runs about 90 m east behind a tree line. Also rents by the month, and a 2020 camper wrote that almost everyone there was on wind-turbine work, so expect long-stay campers. --Claude
summary: City page confirms 82 full-hookup sites (Facebook says 81), showers and laundromat; no operator page posts a rate, so the note-derived $22-27 is cleared (Campendium: $25 undated, $500/month in 2020). Not waterfront confirmed (channelized creek ~90 m east behind trees). Ownership as City of Titonka is unconfirmed and looks doubtful. Note trimmed of field facts.
flags: OWNERSHIP QUESTION (stored local, note said 'City of Titonka campground'): nothing read shows the city runs it. The city lists it on its Recreation page beside the privately run golf course, with phone 515-928-2308 (city hall is 515-928-2850); the campground has its own Gmail address (smidtcampground@gmail.com, per Campendium), its own Facebook page and its own number on Google (515-320-4051); and no city council minutes or code section read mentions a campground. If it is privately owned, the private gates apply: see the next two flags.

LONG-STAY CHARACTER / PRICE: no nightly rate is posted by any operator page (city page, Facebook description). Campendium shows an undated camper-reported '$25' nightly and that weekly and monthly rates are offered; its one review (Amanda128, May 20, 2020): 'almost everyone at the campground was there for work', 'Monthly price was $500, electricity included', 'This is the only RV park in the area that is open through the winter.' A workforce/monthly campground with no posted nightly price fails long-stay test 2. The share of nightly sites is not stated anywhere; fall NAIP shows ~15-20 units on ~80 pads, which doesn't settle it. I read it as possibly mostly long-stay but unproven. Google Maps: 4.8 from 47 reviews (not under 4, so no auto-drop).

PHONE: stored 515-928-2308 is the number on the city's page; Google Maps and Campendium give 515-320-4051 for the campground. Neither is shown to be wrong; the Google number looks like the campground's own line. apply.py does not write phone.

WEBSITE: stored https://titonka.com/what-to-do/recreation/ is the city's listing page (a paragraph and a phone). The campground has no website of its own; its Facebook page is https://www.facebook.com/374421082968271.

WATERFRONT: not waterfront confirmed. NAIP: a gravel grid of back-in pads plus an east row; Buffalo Creek is a straight ditch ~10 m wide ~90 m east of the east row, past a tree belt and grass strip. 'Overlooking Buffalo Creek' is marketing; a creek this size and distance earns nothing.
HOOKUPS: electric 50 (derived from note prose) is left as stored; no page read states the amperage (TheDyrt, an aggregator, says '50 and 30 amp').
PIN: stored 43.24100,-94.03850 is on the pad grid; Google's 43.2416,-94.0383 is ~65 m north. OK.
